title: Online Stock Span
statement:
You are given an array of prices representing the daily price of a stock. For each day, calculate the stock's span.

The span of the stock's price today is defined as the maximum number of consecutive days (starting from today and going backward) for which the stock price was less than or equal to today's price.

Return the space-separated spans for all days.

Use a monotonic stack.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing prices.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers representing the span for each day.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
prices = list(map(int, input().split()))
ans = [0] * n
# Write your solution using a stack tracking (price, span)
print(*ans)
